<tspan x="1051.0" dy="0">ReLU / Dropout</tspan>
</text>
<text xmlns="http://www.w3.org/2000/svg" x="648.0" y="1146" font-family="DejaVu Sans, Arial, sans-serif" font-size="14" font-weight="400" text-anchor="middle" fill="#344155">
<tspan x="648.0" dy="0">B=batch; inputC16 -> outputC32; L16 -> convL20 -> right cropL16.</tspan>
<tspan x="648.0" dy="16.52">Conv1/Conv2 parameter families are independent; shortcut has its own Conv1.</tspan>
<tspan x="648.0" dy="16.52">Legacy weight_norm boundary retained; no upstream model execution.</tspan>
</text>
<text xmlns="http://www.w3.org/2000/svg" x="648.0" y="1250" font-family="DejaVu Sans, Arial, sans-serif" font-size="14" font-weight="400" text-anchor="middle" fill="#344155">
<tspan x="648.0" dy="0">Reviewed static source + selected profile. Repeated groups are templates; shapes are not runtime observations.</tspan>
</text>
<text xmlns="http://www.w3.org/2000/svg" x="648.0" y="1280" font-family="DejaVu Sans, Arial, sans-serif" font-size="14" font-weight="400" text-anchor="middle" fill="#344155">
<tspan x="648.0" dy="0">E### = source span; dashed = side / shape dependencies; fork/join roles are typed in IR; no implicit sum.</tspan>
</text>
<text xmlns="http://www.w3.org/2000/svg" x="648.0" y="1305" font-family="DejaVu Sans, Arial, sans-serif" font-size="14" font-weight="400" text-anchor="middle" fill="#344155">
<tspan x="648.0" dy="0">Repeated colors encode operation roles. Shared weights and independent instances are recorded in semantic_ir.json.</tspan>
</text>
